headline: FIFA abandons plan to sell World Cup revenue stakes
summary: President Gianni Infantino dropped the divisive private-equity proposal after worldwide pushback from the soccer community.
script: FIFA has abandoned its plan to sell a stake in World Cup revenue to private investors. President Gianni Infantino said the proposal had created divisions, after opposition from clubs, federations and fans around the world.
